thread:
Ravi: quick heads-up — onboarding run for quant-v3-lite shows a regression in funcall JSON compliance. parse failures ~1.8% since 03:40 UTC.
Mei: sample?
Ravi: pasted one below (sensitive fields redacted):
```
{"name":"create_issue","args":{"title":"Regression observed","body":"..."}}

<stream_chunk: 0x1f>

{"name":"assign","args":{"user":"redacted"}}
```
Ravi: the <stream_chunk> marker is literally an unprintable control fragment inserted between JSON objects in the stream. decoders expecting NDJSON choke.
Noah: is this from streaming boundary coalescing? did we change the chunk framing when switching to faster emitter in qv3?
Mei: quant-v3-lite build notes: switched to low-memory emitter, enabled continuous batching, and turned on aggressive output packing. floating baseline didn't have packing.
Noah: sounds like packing may concatenate chunks without adding proper separator or is leaving a raw binary fragment. can you grep for 0x1f writes in the runtime?
Ravi: did a quick grep — found a write in packer.c that emits 0x1f as a delimiter for internal tracing but it's wrapped in #ifdef TRACE_PACK. somehow TRACE_PACK ended up enabled in the build config for v3-lite.
Tess: ops-bot, can you roll traffic back to quant-v2-stable while we fix?
ops-bot: Routing change 4293010005: canary -> quant-v2-stable initiated by @Tess
Mei: short-term mitigation: parser-rescue that strips lines containing non-utf8/control markers before JSON decode, and count those as soft errors. will PR sanitize + telemetry tagging.
Noah: longer-term: remove trace delimiter or gate it behind runtime debug channel only; add an automated onboarding eval that verifies NDJSON streams for a 5k sample window.
Ravi: also discovered this only reproduces when batch_size >= 6 and kv_cache=true with streaming=true. smaller batches are fine.
Mei: that helps root-cause — the packer path for merged batches uses a thin buffer and appends trace marker on merge. for now I'll disable TRACE_PACK for the release build and publish re-export.
Tess: testers, please prepare a canary eval: run funcall-suite with these knobs (batch_size=6, kv_cache=on, streaming=on) against new artifact before flip.
Noah: I'll add a unit that simulates stdout pollution and assert the NDJSON sanitizer flags it. PR by EOD.
Ravi: thanks all. tagging @product-devex to add this NDJSON-sanity check to onboarding checklist. will post follow-up when re-exported artifact is on canary. :thumbsup:
